spanish: Porque será a ellos palabra, vino a mí, y juzgaré entre varón y entre su compañero, y haré conocer estatutos de Dios y sus leyes.
grammarChanges: viene → vino: בָּא is qal perfect 3ms; changed present to past so the Spanish carries the perfect.
juzgo → juzgaré: sequence of tenses — the sequential perfect continues the future time-frame set by imperfect יִהְיֶה (será).
hago conocer → haré conocer: same sequence-of-tenses repair, continuing the future time-frame set by será.
torás → leyes: תּוֹרֹתָיו is a common noun (fem. plural + 3ms suffix); translated the lemma instead of leaving it as a Hebraized loanword.
